commits.message: Add login page and session store

messages.text: The app keeps bouncing between /login and /dashboard after I sign in. Can you look at the redirect logic?

### Root cause

The loop comes from two guards disagreeing about the session cookie:

- `resolveRoute` redirects `/dashboard` to `/login` when `isAuthenticated()` is false
- the login handler then sends you back to `/dashboard` because the cookie write raced the next navigation
- the cookie is scoped `SameSite=Lax`, so the first redirect never carries it

Fix by awaiting the cookie write before navigating:

```ts
await session.commit();
navigate("/dashboard");
```

After that the guard sees `atlas_session` on the first pass and the loop stops.
That makes sense. Can you also check whether the auth middleware runs on the OAuth callback route?

Yes — `/auth/callback` was inside the guarded group, so a fresh login bounced to `/login` before the callback could set the cookie. I moved the callback route outside the guard; the middleware now only wraps `/dashboard` and the other authenticated pages.
Add a dark mode toggle in the header that persists the choice to localStorage.

Done. The header now has a toggle that writes `atlas-theme` to localStorage, and `App.tsx` reads it on mount so the choice survives reloads. The default still follows `prefers-color-scheme` when nothing is stored.
TestCharge fails about one run in five in CI but never locally. What's going on?

The test shares a package-level RNG seed with the retry helper, so it depends on test order under `go test -shuffle=on` (CI enables it). I gave the test its own seeded source and the flakes stopped in a 200-run stress loop.
Help me brainstorm launch names for the release next week.
A few directions: Daybreak (fresh start), Perihelion (closest approach, big energy), and Greenlight (obvious ship metaphor). Daybreak pairs nicely with the new light theme announcement.
